messages.snippet: You're invited to our December know-how seminar on drafting and negotiating limitation of liability
messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: drafting limitation of liability clauses (12 Dec)
messages.plaintextBody: You're invited to our December know-how seminar on drafting and negotiating limitation of liability and indemnity clauses in commercial contracts, with a focus on caps, carve-outs and consequential-loss exclusions. Thursday 12 December, 12:30, Training Room 2. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
